intent: Detect the archived-payment fraud hit via impossible-travel leg-speed analysis over archived payment_transactions and cite every fraud record_path without mutating files.
success_criteria: Only payment_transactions with is_archived_basket_reference=1 are considered
Per customer_id, rows ordered by payment_created_at; incoming (LAG) and outgoing (LEAD) leg speeds in deg/hr computed
A record is flagged fraud when its incoming OR outgoing leg speed exceeds ~2 deg/hr
No files are written or deleted (read-only)
answer refs contain the exact record_path of every flagged payment plus /docs/security.md

args.stdin:
WITH legs AS (
  SELECT
    payment_id,
    record_path,
    customer_id,
    payment_created_at,
    observed_latitude AS lat,
    observed_longitude AS lon,
    LAG(observed_latitude)  OVER w AS prev_lat,
    LAG(observed_longitude) OVER w AS prev_lon,
    LAG(payment_created_at) OVER w AS prev_ts,
    LEAD(observed_latitude)  OVER w AS next_lat,
    LEAD(observed_longitude) OVER w AS next_lon,
    LEAD(payment_created_at) OVER w AS next_ts
  FROM payment_transactions
  WHERE is_archived_basket_reference = 1
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_created_at)
),
speeds AS (
  SELECT
    payment_id,
    record_path,
    (ABS(lat - prev_lat) + ABS(lon - prev_lon)) / NULLIF((julianday(payment_created_at) - julianday(prev_ts)) * 24.0, 0) AS in_speed,
    (ABS(next_lat - lat) + ABS(next_lon - lon)) / NULLIF((julianday(next_ts) - julianday(payment_created_at)) * 24.0, 0) AS out_speed
  FROM legs
)
SELECT record_path, payment_id
FROM speeds
WHERE COALESCE(in_speed, 0) > 2.0 OR COALESCE(out_speed, 0) > 2.0
ORDER BY record_path;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.

answer_template.message: Risk Ops fraud hit confirmed in archived payment history via impossible-travel detection (incoming/outgoing leg speed > 2 deg/hr over is_archived_basket_reference=1 records, ordered per customer by payment_created_at). Flagged {fraud_records.count} payment records as fraud: {fraud_records.record_paths}. No files changed. Grounded in /docs/security.md.
